execution_evidence.leaf: rmcp-v3.1.4 task lifecycle authorization-context propagation under Streamable HTTP
execution_evidence.summary: get_task, update_task, and cancel_task each receive RequestContext<RoleServer>; Streamable HTTP injects http::request::Parts into inbound request Extensions and the generic service loop moves those Extensions into RequestContext.extensions. Therefore a trusted middleware Principal inside Parts.extensions is available through one fail-closed nested lookup in call_tool and all handler-exposed task methods on the evidenced Streamable HTTP paths. tasks/get returns GetTaskResult; no separate get_task_result handler was found.
execution_evidence.scope_limit: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 Streamable HTTP source paths only; no claim for stdio/custom transports or for correctness of a specific authentication middleware.
